prompts.electric:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture atlas for a handcrafted PAPER pop-up battle terrarium, Pokémon Emerald Mauville electric gym. Generate ONE square 2048x2048 RGBA atlas with transparent gutters. Everything handmade from FLAT overlapping cut colored paper, visible cream cut edges, fibrous matte cardstock, shallow soft contact shadows; like a sophisticated paper theatre, NOT thick 3D objects, NOT voxel, NOT photoreal metal. Rich designed detail, clean readable silhouettes.
STRICT LAYOUT in normalized coordinates:
TOP HALF (x 0.02-0.98, y 0.02-0.48): one wide symmetrical rear stage facade, squat semicircular silhouette (low sides, tall center), yellow and deep petrol electrical gym switchboard architecture. Central circular lightning emblem on a teal control wall, alternating yellow insulating pillars, layered copper paper wires, small side galleries and electrical cabinets, 3 lamp arrays. The facade extends to a flat baseline at y .48, no ground extending forward. No Pokeball shell, no people, no Pokémon, no text.
BOTTOM LEFT QUADRANT (x .02-.48,y .52-.98): a fully filled SQUARE straight top-down floor texture. Slate teal hexagonal paper tiles, cream central battle circle with subtle Pokeball line, yellow copper circuit paths near perimeter; clear flat center. No perspective, no transparent gaps within this floor square.
BOTTOM RIGHT QUADRANT: four isolated fully visible paper props in a 2x2 grid with big transparent gutters. At x .53-.74,y .53-.73: short wide hexagonal trainer platform, teal and ochre layered paper, flat cream top seen from 20 degrees above, aspect 2.5:1. At x .77-.98,y .53-.73: freestanding coil tower made of flat overlapping ochre disc silhouettes and blue paper insulator, with two prominent yellow contacts at top, no painted lightning. At x .53-.74,y .77-.98: short foreground fence with yellow chevron stripes and three little blue signal lamps. At x .77-.98,y .77-.98: small control console and coiled paper cable, teal with orange switches. No prop touches another or any atlas boundary.
Entire atlas orthographic front view EXCEPT floor is top down and platform cap has drawn perspective. Transparent background outside individual shapes and floor. No labels, no borders, no text, no gradients behind assets. Crisp exact silhouettes, coherent premium paper craft art, bright readable palette.
prompts.electricRepair: Edit target: supplied electric-gym cut-paper atlas. Keep the same composition, all four bottom-right props, bottom-left floor tile, palette, paper texture and transparency. Repair only the upper facade: its central yellow column is clipped by the top image edge. Give this facade a complete clean rounded top silhouette and 45 pixels of transparent margin above it. Compress the facade vertically slightly within the same top-half cell to make room, keeping its flat baseline where it is. Do not crop anything. All parts stay separate with transparent gutters. No new elements, no text.
